question: Which of the following article of the Constitution lays down that the National Flag and National Anthem must be respected?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Art 51A (a)__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 51A** is a **Fundamental Duty** in **Part IV** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The idea of incorporating Fundamental Duties into the Indian constitution was inspired by the **Russian Constitution (erstwhile Soviet Union)**.
 
• They help in promoting the **spirit of discipline** and **patriotism** among the citizens.
 
• Additionally, they assist in** achieving societal objectives** by encouraging active citizen participation instead of the spectator.
 
• Ten Fundamental Duties were added by the** 42nd Constitution Amendment Act in 1976** on the recommendation of the **Swaran Singh Committee**.
